codeChangeSummary.commandsRs: start_listening: removed the pre-flight `speech_engine.is_ready()` early-return that ran before `audio_engine.start()`; audio capture now starts unconditionally (subject to the existing, unchanged device-resolution/AudioEngineError handling). Speech readiness is now checked only after a successful `audio_engine.start()`, solely to decide whether `AppEvent::SpeechStarted` is honestly recorded/emitted (never fabricated). stop_listening mirrors the same rule for `AppEvent::SpeechStopped`. Command names, parameters, and return types are unchanged.
codeChangeSummary.liveChurchBrainTsx: Start Listening button's `disabled` condition no longer includes `status.speechStatus === "unavailable"`. The SPEECH UNAVAILABLE notice text was clarified to state that audio capture (input level, acoustic/music recognition) and manual operation remain available even though live transcription will not run. The already-computed `status.audio.inputLevel` (existing RMS mechanism, no new meter) is now rendered next to the device selector while listening, distinguishing NO SIGNAL from SIGNAL CAPTURED, and noting whether transcription is active.
